new_findings.summary: German foreword correctly identifies VDV 301-2-10 as the TimeService document, while the English foreword says VDV 301-2-1 describes TimeService.
new_findings.normative_validation_impact: documentation/resolver only; never route TimeService to VDV 301-2-1 from this sentence

new_findings.summary: German service text explicitly says cyclic transmission of the current time is not intended, while the adjacent English service section omits this sentence.
new_findings.normative_validation_impact: runtime/profile interpretation; _ibisip_udp._udp must not be treated as evidence of a generic cyclic time-broadcast service

new_findings.summary: English V1.0 version-history text prints 'cd. 1' after the _ibisip_udp._udp service-type correction, an editorial/cross-reference artifact with no technical meaning established by the source.

existing_finding_updates.effect: Historical context resolved. The 07/2016 VDV 301-2 base writing points TimeService to VDV 301-2-11; VDV-Mitteilung 3002 from 10/2016 already lists TimeService as VDV-301-2-10, and VDV 301-2-11 is the 05/2017 VideoLiveService writing. Reclassify as a high-confidence wrong/stale document-number cross-reference rather than unresolved historical numbering. Do not route TimeService to 301-2-11.

runtime_evidence_update.effect: Fresh TimeService read retains existing discovery/SNTP/timezone rules and adds an explicit deterministic guard that cyclic transmission of current time is not expected.
runtime_evidence_update.authority: official VDV TimeService V1.0 profile plus RFC 4330 where referenced
